headline: Alicorp Acquires Rama Margarine and 18 Brands for US$150.5 Million
summary: Peruvian food and consumer goods company Alicorp has completed the acquisition of Flora Food Group’s Latin American spreads business, including Colombian brand Rama, 18 other brands, and a production plant in Cali, for approximately US$150.5 million.
why: Alicorp is a major consumer goods company in Peru, and this cross-border acquisition expands its footprint in the Latin American food and margarine market.
